page_title: WER 2-1 KOL | Werder Bremen v FC Koln 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 9:8.
90+4' Golden chance! Naby Keita (Werder Bremen) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
90+3' Naby Keita (Werder Bremen) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
90+2' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Naby Keita (Werder Bremen) replaces Romano Schmid.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Damion Downs (1. FC Koln) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He planted a header against the left post and it glanced away off it.
88' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
85' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
85' Looks like Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dejan Ljubicic departs the field of play to be replaced by Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln).
83' Linton Maina will be replaced by Damion Downs (1. FC Koln).

54' Bastian Dankert blows for a foul after Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
51' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) is able to continue to play.
50' The game is interrupted now, Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Werder Bremen get a corner.
47' Corner kick. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity.

47' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Marvin Schwabe makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! It will be a corner kick for Werder Bremen.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
42' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) smashes the ball towards the top right corner of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant reflex save. Good work from Werder Bremen as they win a corner.
38' 1 - 1 GOAL! Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) runs onto a pass from Marvin Ducksch after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:1.
36' Bastian Dankert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
35' FC Koln take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
31' 0 - 1 Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the top right corner, and thus alter the score to 0:1.
30' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is about to take a corner kick.
27' The corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by the defence.
26' The referee points to the corner flag and Werder Bremen will take a corner.
26' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
26' The ball is out of play and Werder Bremen manage to earn a corner.
25' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Now Werder Bremen have a corner.
25' The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
21' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Bastian Dankert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
18' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
16' FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
15' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
14' FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
7' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
6' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
5' Corner kick. Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is ready to send the ball into the box.
4' Neat passing move from FC Koln in order to create new attacking opportunities.
